claim: Train-only target construction and split eligibility are fixed before evaluation.
The selected model is chosen only on validation metrics with fixed seeds and a tie rule.
Gate A and Gate B comparisons use paired year-block uncertainty on identical locked rows.
Tail, rank, and top-k gate components are reproducible from row-level locked predictions.
Temporal robustness is evaluated by rolling-origin and prefix-capacity diagnostics.
Stage-feature sensitivity is a sensitivity design, not a replacement for the primary feature set.
Crop, subgroup, and spatial diagnostics are diagnostic and cannot promote a failed primary gate.
Full-series detrending is retrospective and changes event membership relative to train-only targets.
Baselines, model-family contrasts, and bootstrap schemes use saved vectors and hashes.
Every submission-facing number is checked against generated artifacts and the final PDF.
